MONDE01.text:
- PROLOGUE -

This chronicle is unlike any other:
It spans centuries and traces the
entire history, from the distant past
to the present... and the possible
future, of your world.
Conferred to the Leader of every
clan, it will show you what needs
to be done.


Read this journal with care, it will
serve as your only guide through a
perilous quest.


.../...
CHAPTER I
IN THE BEGINNING:
THE DAWN OF THE
NEW WORLD

- Mission 1 -

Greetings mysterious visitor.
I hope you're not afraid... or do I
detect an anxious tear in your eye?
A word of warning: this venture is
not for the faint of heart!

This world you are about to
uncover, and the challenges you
will meet there, will require you to
fight fearlessly... and intelligently.
.../...
But I'm getting ahead of myself.
For the moment, everything is just
fine!... Aside from the fact that
your clan desperately lacks food
and ressources... and the Assassins
Guild terrorizing the region isn't
making life any easier!

It might be a good idea to amass
a reserve of food and building
materials.


Synopsis:
Secure a cave
Stock 50 sacks of food and
50 sacks of stones in the cave

metadata.title: - Mission 1 -
objectives: 50 sacks of stones in the cave

MONDE02.text:
- Mission 2 -

Well, what do you know?
You're back! I guess I was right
about you, after all. 
But I'm still not convinced that
your diplomatic skills are up to par!
At one point, I thought your
indecision would put and end to
our brief friendship. This world is
now yours, and the only way
forward will be to succeed. If you
are to do so, it is crucial that your
pitiful army learn the meaning of
combat.
But let's get to the point...

.../...


Synopsis:
Build a Sanctuary.
Build a Barrack.
Stock 50 sacks of food.

MONDE03.text:
- Mission 3 -

Things aren't as simple as they
seem in the realm you now
possess!

I can't help but notice that your
populace is developing rather
slowly... If you intend to get
anywhere in this life, there's an vital
element you can't afford to neglect:
KNOWLEDGE!

It may not seem important in the
grand scope of things, but
knowledge can bring about
impressive results.
.../...
To make the best use of your time,
I advise you to build a Laboratory
to carry out your research.
As you may have noticed, your
cave days are over!


Synopsis:
Build a Laboratory.
Develop a technology.

MONDE04.text:
- Mission 4 -

You've made your first discovery?

I wouldn't be so cocky if I were
you: a confidential report 
(yes, I have my connections...)
informed me that you're not alone
any more.
A clan not unlike your own is
established nearby.

The first encounter will probably be
rough, but it's possible that this
confrontation could work to the
advantage of both populations.

.../...


Synopsis:
Build a Market.
Train a Messenger to forge an
alliance with the Red Clan.
Destroy the rival Clan if no alliance
is possible.

metadata.title: - Mission 4 -
objectives: Train a Messenger to forge an
Destroy the rival Clan if no alliance

MONDE05.text:
- Mission 5 -

It was bound to happen: Other
Clans have entered your realm!
Consider this piece of advice, as it
may bear upon your future:
Friends can be your key to success,
but forming alliances takes talent
and finesse...

You'll need to master the art of
diplomacy, or suffer the
consequences...

Synopsis: 
Meet the three other Clans
Eliminate enemy Clans (any Clan
with whom you are not allied)

metadata.title: - Mission 5 -
objectives: with whom you are not allied)

MONDE06.text:
- CHAPTER II -
Today:
"MIGHT & TERROR"

- Mission 6 -

I see you have vanquished
your enemy.
It is my duty to tell you that your
every action from this point on
could work for or against you 
But don't imagine your enemies
have forgotten the bitter defeats
you dealt them!
Nor should you delude yourself
into believing that friendship
(or enmity) lasts forever...
.../... 
Or perhaps you've already noticed?
If there is one thing you will soon
understand, it is that Knowledge is
sometimes attained by treading a
Spiritual path...
An ancient parchment mentions a
cave, or an abandoned Mine, where
arcane and mystical knowledge
still resides.

Synopsis:
- Explore the Mine, where you will
obtain Spiritual Knowledge.

metadata.title: - Mission 6 -
objectives: Explore the Mine, where you will

MONDE07.text:
- Mission 7 -

I've just received an alarming
report: every other Clan in the
region has been annihilated by
strange, terrifying creatures.
You absolutely must repel these
creatures' attacks and develop a
stable economy in order to leave
this accursed domain.
But don't let this setback keep your 
Clan from growing: you must 
discover new technologies if you 
want to move on to friendlier 
territory.

Synopsis: 
Develop two technologies.

MONDE08.text:
- Mission 8 -

The crystal has profoundly altered
people's convictions.

You hoped the other Clans would
not discover your secret? I believe
it has already reached enemy ears!
You have led your people across
desolate lands and have finally
reached the farthest shores of this
continent. The eastern lands would
seem to be ideal for the expansion
you envisioned.
The first Clan to successfully cross
the ocean can hope to build a better
world.
.../...


Synopsis: 
Cross the ocean and build a
Sanctuary.

metadata.title: - Mission 8 -
objectives: Cross the ocean and build a

MONDE09.text:
- CHAPTER III -
"A New Age"

- Mission 9 -

Competition is a necessary evil,
but it can have its good points.
However, be advised that sore
losers could try to spoil this
adventure for you.

You must establish your Clan's
authority in this unfamiliar land and
help your people acquire new
Knowledge. (Don't forget to build
a Laboratory.)

.../...
I've just received given a most
helpful intelligence report on the
Clans of Rising Lands. Only one
word comes to mind that describes
them: pitiful.
You surely were able to observe
this for yourself: rascals and rogues
are in the majority.
You must prove your courage but
also your skill if you want to
maintain your command of this
realm.


Synopsis:
Make two discoveries.

MONDE10.text:
- Mission 10. -

I have just received an urgent
missive from one of the clans:
they've been mercilessly routed by
repulsive and sinister monsters;
of course, they must mean
Shadow Creatures.

This news confirms my worst fears:
dangerous forces are closing in on
you. You must show your
opponents that you are in control.
There is only one solution: total
destruction of all enemy Clans.

Synopsis:
Destroy enemy Clans.

MONDE11.text:
- Mission 11 -

These blasted Shadow Creatures
seem to have a talent for being
everywhere at once! 
(especially where you
don't expect them!)

You astonish me! What nerves of
steel! Naturally, those tiny beads of
sweat running down your forehead
must stem from your considerable
efforts.
These physical and mental
challenges are teaching your people
to  "stand on their own two feet."

.../...
You are about to cross an
impoverished land - a dreary
quagmire riddled with hidden traps.
You must conquer these swamps
and establish a strong base if you
hope to move on.


Synopsis:
Cross the swamps.
Produce 50 sacks of food.
Develop one technology.

MONDE12.text:
- Mission 12 -

I am a bit disappointed in you:
caught like a real amateur.
Wasn't my advice of any
use to you?

You must take action - and fast!
You've got to get out of here and
establish a new Sanctuary to the
Northeast.

Synopsis: 
Break through the enemy blocade.
Build a Sanctuary in the Northeast.
Destroy all enemy Clans.

metadata.title: - Mission 12 -
objectives: Build a Sanctuary in the Northeast.

MONDE13.text:
- Mission 13 -

You deserve a holiday!

It's time for the great annual
Builders Race! 
No one can refuse to participate. 
The winner gains (or regains) the
esteem of the other Clans.

If you emerge the victor, the other
Clans will be more inclined to
become your allies. The result of
the race will also determine where
you begin the next mission. If you
loose, your future will be dark
indeed!
.../...


Synopsis: 
Build a Sanctuary, as quickly as
possible, in the East.

metadata.title: - Mission 13 -
objectives: Build a Sanctuary, as quickly as

MONDE14.text:
- Mission 14 -

It seems our enemies deliberately
chose not to follow us along this
path... this doesn't bode well...

I came across a parchment, and as I
read it aloud, I felt an indescribable
sensation... A horrifying vision
appeared before me: I'm afraid
I inadvertently awakened
Shadow Creatures!
They didn't even seem to notice
me, but ran straight in your
direction...


.../...

These frenzied creatures are
arriving by the thousands! 
You'll have to do your best to
resist them!


Synopsis:
Resist the creatures.
Build a Sanctuary
and a Storehouse.
Produce 50 blocks of stones
and 100 sacks of food.

MONDE15.text:
- Mission 15 -

The vast plains surrounding you
seem to invite your Clan to expand!
Unfortunately, the terrain is barren
and can't provide the stones and
food you'll need.
Alliances will be more difficult to
secure, but you'll need friends if
you want to achieve your goal.

You must resolve internal problems
and manage your development...

Synopsis:
Expand your Clan.
Destroy the enemy.

MONDE16.text:
- Mission 16 -

The last place you stopped was
barren: you need to replenish your
supplies. A local chatterbox
warned me that Shadow Creatures
are roaming the area!

I couldn't help but notice that your
neighbors seem unusually nervous;
I wouldn't hesitate to destroy any
enemy. Oh, and don't forget to
develop a new technology.

Synopsis:
Destroy enemy Clans
Develop a new technology

MONDE17.text:
Mission 17 -


You just can't trust anyone these
days... The traitor got help from
those evil and scheming wretches:
the Shadow Creatures...

They are preparing to annihilate
you once and for all, which is why
your people are now imprisoned.
You absolutely must escape and
return to your village
(the woods should shield
you from  prying eyes).


.../...
Once you have taken your life into
your own hands again you will
have to destroy the enemy camp, to
discourage anyone else who would
dare to commit such an infamous
crime.

Synopsis:
Escape from prison.
Return to your Clan.
Destroy enemy Clans.

MONDE18.text:
- CHAPTER IV -

- Mission 18 -

It seems to be getting more and
more difficult to form alliances
with other Clans. From what my
spies have told me, the Shadow
Creatures are behind the chaos that
reigns among the Clans. Moreover,
rumors of an abandoned Sanctuary
holding a fabulous treasure has
only sharpened hostilities.

You'd best heed this old adage:
"Persistence can foster
any alliance".
.../...


Synopsis:
Find the hidden Sanctuary
and reactivate it.

MONDE19.text:
- Mission 19 -

Inside the Sanctuary, you
discovered a message saying:
"The future lies to the Southeast".

You will have to cross this volcanic
terrain as fast as you can: these
desolate lands are under the
Shadow Creatures' dominion.
I detected the tracks of these
accursed creatures, along with
those of beasts I've never before
encountered! Exploring these lands
won't be easy:
Your enemies are lurking in the
shadows, ready to destroy you.
.../...


Proceed Southeast with caution
and you will certainly find
the solution to your problems...


Synopsis:
Build your Sanctuary
to the Southeast.

MONDE20.text:
- Mission 20 -

This desolate place
really isn't for you!

You must persevere and guide your
Clan across this inhospitable terrain
toward Southeast, where you will
build a Sanctuary.
But be vigilant! Your enemies are 
as treacherous as ever...
... one mistake could be your last.

Synopsis:
Build a Sanctuary Southeast.

MONDE21.text:
- Mission 21 -

Will this dreary landscape ever
come to an end? Nothing but
molten rock and lava as far as the
eye can see...

The further you advance, the more
violent and fearless the Creatures
grow. The only possible escape is
to continue Southeast and build a
Sanctuary there.

Synopsis:
Build a Sanctuary to the Southeast.
Destroy all enemy Clans.

metadata.title: - Mission 21 -
objectives: Build a Sanctuary to the Southeast.

MONDE22.text:
- Mission 22 -

It would seem we have finally
come to the end of this Shadow
Creature-infested hellhole.
Courage! Just one final push to
escape these hostile lands! You'll
still have to establish a Sanctuary
Southeast of this region.
I'm confident you'll succeed:
I've had many opportunities to
appreciate your quick thinking and
sense of diplomacy.

Synopsis:
Build a Sanctuary to the Southeast.
Destroy all enemy Clans.

metadata.title: - Mission 22 -
objectives: Build a Sanctuary to the Southeast.

MONDE23.text:
- Mission 23 -

There's no doubt about it:
your desperate trek is near its end.

You'll soon be traveling the
well-worn paths and green plains
you've dreamed of...
the Shadow Creatures' domain
but a fading memory.
But before you can frolic through
your lava-free world, you'll have to
emigrate Southeast and take
possession of the Library!

Synopsis:
Take over the Great Library
to the Southeast.

MONDE24.text:
- Mission 24 -

I've just received an important
message: the fertile lands you've
dreamed of since this adventure
began are located...
to the Southeast!

You should build a Sanctuary there
as fast as possible.
As you will see for yourself, your
task won't be easy: rumors of a
massive and hostile presence to the
South East abound...


Synopsis:
Build a Sanctuary to the Southeast.

metadata.title: - Mission 24 -
objectives: Build a Sanctuary to the Southeast.

MONDE25.text:
- Mission 25 -

At last! The Rising Lands you've
dreamed of for so long are within
your grasp!
 
But for this adventure to come to
an end, you must ensure your
Clan's peaceful existence in these
new lands…
Be merciless and annihilate your
enemies!


Synopsis:
- Defeat anyone who opposes you.
